content.text: I reviewed each answer-key item against the record and the transcript, checking final figures (QCD $15,000 not $12,000; remaining RMD $32,388; $70,000 conversion; ~$40,000 Kettleby) and the final owners/dates (parish info moved from Lorraine to Everett; projection moved from the 23rd to Friday the 30th). Note that the meeting was Thursday, October 15, 2026, so "Monday" = Oct 19, "Tuesday" = Oct 20 and "Wednesday" = Oct 21.

key_items.note: Missing. The birth of granddaughter Maisie Jane on August 27, 2026 (Nathan and Jess's daughter) is discussed at length early in the call but appears nowhere in the record; item 1 is the only life event and it captures the surgery.

Captures the right knee replacement on November 17. Date matches; no figures to check. Omits the supporting detail (one or two nights, six weeks PT, no driving for a month) but nothing stated is wrong.

QCD of $15,000 from Everett's IRA payable to St. Fintan Parish. Uses the corrected $15,000 figure, not the superseded $12,000 pledge. Does not mention it counts toward his 2026 RMD, but no figure is wrong.

Missing. No record item covers the regular distribution of the remaining $32,388 in the first week of December with 50% federal withholding (about $16,200) — a significant omission, since that withholding is what funds the tax on the conversion.

Roth conversion of $70,000 from Lorraine's traditional IRA to her Roth. Amount matches the final figure confirmed at 00:21:46. Does not note the first-week-of-December timing or zero federal/state withholding, but carries no wrong figure.

Kettleby stock of about $40,000 from the joint account to a new DAF at Carrow Valley Community Foundation. Amount correct. Omits the fund name (Stadtler Family Fund) and the ~540 whole shares, but states no wrong figure.

Owner correctly reflects the handoff from Lorraine to Everett at 00:20:08. Due date wrong: Everett said he would email it Monday morning, which is October 19, 2026; the record's 'Monday, October 16, 2026' is an impossible date (Oct 16 is a Friday). Also drops the acknowledgment-letter ask, which is a detail, not an error.

Owner Joelle is right. Due date wrong: Joelle said she could have it out Wednesday, i.e. October 21, 2026; the record's 'Wednesday, October 18, 2026' is an impossible date (Oct 18 is a Sunday). Adding Lorraine as a signer is loose — the QCD is from Everett's IRA — but the task is recognisably the same.

Owner Tobias and recipients (Everett, Lorraine, Hal) match. Due date correctly uses the revised Friday, October 30, 2026 rather than the abandoned 23rd, which Joelle flagged because of the custodian conference.

Same subject matter (DAF application plus stock transfer letter) so paired here, but materially distorted. Owner should be Joelle, who committed to send both documents out; the record assigns it to Everett. Due should be Tuesday, October 20, 2026 (Joelle: 'out to both of you by Tuesday'), not 'Monday, October 16, 2026', which is again an impossible date. The signing-before-surgery framing is a real constraint but is not the committed deliverable.

Missing. Lorraine committed at 00:21:29 to call Hal Dettweiler tomorrow to book a first-half-of-November tax meeting ahead of the surgery and to ask about the state tax on the conversion. Nothing in the record covers this.

Missing. Joelle's commitment to prepare the two separate forms (Lorraine's conversion with zero withholding, Everett's December RMD distribution with 50% federal withholding), dated to process the first week of December and signed before the 17th, is not recorded. Record item 8 covers only the DAF/stock paperwork, not these forms.

extra_items.note: The transcript establishes this: Tobias proposed a follow-up call and both clients confirmed 'Wednesday, December 9th, 10 a.m., by video' to review the completed conversion. December 9, 2026 is indeed a Wednesday, consistent with the meeting date. Owner Tobias is reasonable as the person who set it; the NOT_FOUND due date is acceptable since no separate deadline was given.
